facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: New baseline tools: Holy Strike at 6, an instant Holy-damage weapon strike (10 s cooldown since 24 Sep), and Seal of Fury at 10, a tanking Seal that adds Holy damage to each swing plus an absorb worth half of it. Judging Seal of Fury taunts from 10 yards.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Judgement no longer consumes your Seal. Consecration (full damage on the first 4 enemies only) and Blessing of Kings are baseline at 20, and Lay on Hands drops from a 1-hour to a 20-minute cooldown.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Fire, Frost and Shadow Resistance Auras now reach raid members within 30 yards; in beta testing the other auras stayed party-only.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Blizzard removed Salvation, Mass Salvation, Revoke and Blessing of Light. Righteous Fury is now trained at level 10.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Seal twisting is no longer baseline. November replaces the old Twist of Light capstone with Unsealed Wrath, a 31-point Retribution talent that requires Repentance.

facts.label: Announced by Blizzard
facts.value: Holy adds Oath of Light and Boundless Light. Protection adds Stoicism and Shieldsworn and loses Improved Seal of Fury and One-Handed Weapon Specialization. Retribution adds Turn Evil and Unsealed Wrath and loses Instrument of Law.

facts.label: Talent data: Classic Holy talents that are gone
facts.value: Holy: Consecration, Improved Lay on Hands, Improved Blessing of Wisdom and Lasting Judgement are no longer in the tree.

facts.label: Talent data: Classic Protection talents that are gone
facts.value: Protection: Improved Devotion Aura, Blessing of Kings, Improved Concentration Aura, Blessing of Sanctuary and One-Handed Weapon Specialization are no longer in the tree.

facts.label: Talent data: Classic Retribution talents that are gone
facts.value: Retribution: Improved Blessing of Might, Improved Seal of the Crusader, Improved Retribution Aura and Sanctity Aura are no longer in the tree.

facts.label: Not settled yet
facts.value: Beta observations from Warcraft Tavern (21 Sep), not in Blizzard's notes: 5-minute Blessings and Greater Blessings lasting 1 hour, and Divine Shield halving your damage dealt instead of slowing your attacks.

facts.label: The Tome of Divinity (12)
facts.value: Alliance quest that grants Redemption (Warcraft Tavern, warcraft.wiki.gg).

facts.label: The Tome of Valor, then The Test of Righteousness (20)
facts.value: Teaches Sense Undead and gives the Bastion of Stormwind shield. Jordan Stilwell then forges Verigan's Fist, a two-handed mace, from materials found in Deadmines, Shadowfang Keep, Loch Modan and Ashenvale. In beta it gained a Holy Forgefire proc against fire and earth elementals (Warcraft Tavern, warcraft.wiki.gg).

facts.label: Must be Delgren (22)
facts.value: Listed by Warcraft Tavern with Cloak of the Divine Storm as the reward. It looks Alliance-side, but no other details were found.

facts.label: Summon Warhorse (40)
facts.value: Sources disagree: Warcraft Tavern lists it as a trainer unlock alongside Apprentice Riding, while warcraft.wiki.gg links it to 'The Tome of Nobility'.

facts.label: Summon Charger (60)
facts.value: Classic: a long chain from Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker that ends with 'Judgment and Redemption' in Scholomance. Warcraft Tavern lists the Forever quest as unknown.

facts.label: Crit and mana
facts.value: Holy Power now increases the critical healing bonus of Holy spells by 10% per point, up to 50%. Illumination moved to row 3.

facts.label: Infusion of Light
facts.value: Holy Shock and Flash of Light crits cut 0.5 sec (rank 1) or 1.0 sec (rank 2) off your next Holy Light within 15 sec.

facts.label: Casting under pressure
facts.value: Spiritual Focus has five points on row 1. Reverence has two points on row 2. The November notes keep each talent's maximum effect unchanged.

facts.label: Light's Vigil
facts.value: It now targets friendly players only. The offensive effects were removed.

facts.label: Holy spell hit
facts.value: Divine Precision grants 4% or 8% hit with Holy spells and reduces time spent silenced.

facts.label: Healing Light
facts.value: Raises Holy Light, Flash of Light and Holy Shock healing by 4% at rank 1, up to 12% at rank 3.

facts.label: Role
facts.value: Blizzard's intent: the strongest single-target healer, viable in all group content, with group healing that needs planning.

facts.label: Resistance auras
facts.value: Fire, Frost and Shadow Resistance Auras reach raid members within 30 yards. That helps on Onyxia, where Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before entering.

facts.label: Threat after Salvation
facts.value: Salvation, Mass Salvation and Revoke were removed. Give the tank time to establish threat on pulls.

facts.label: Blessing of Light
facts.value: Blessing of Light was removed. Oath of Light is a Holy talent that strengthens healing on one ally.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: Holy Paladins were welcome single-target raid healers, and managing assigned Blessings and Auras was a core raid job.

facts.label: Classic healer kit
facts.value: Flask of Distilled Wisdom, Elixir of the Sages, Major Mana Potion, Mageblood Potion, Demonic and Dark Runes, Nightfin Soup, Sagefish Delight and wizard oils (from a Classic healer guide).

facts.label: Forever alchemy
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern says healing potions moved from Alchemy to First Aid and flasks are brewed at a portable Alchemy Laboratory camp object.

facts.label: Camp buffs vs Blessings
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern: profession camp objects give weaker copies of class buffs (the Kings-like one gives 8% instead of 10%) that don't stack with the real buff.

facts.label: Flasks
facts.value: In Classic only one flask is active at a time, and it persists through death.

facts.label: Threat
facts.value: Righteous Fury raises all threat by 33% and adds a further 90% threat bonus to Holy damage.

facts.label: Reckoning
facts.value: Per the 16 Oct notes, Reckoning stores up to 4 charges and releases them all on your next auto-attack.

facts.label: Shield Specialization
facts.value: Two points give 15% or 30% more shield block value and a 50% or 100% chance to restore 4% of maximum mana.

facts.label: Cooldowns
facts.value: Swift Judgement releases your active Seal and has a separate cooldown from Judgement. Templar's Bulwark sits on row 3 and can be dispelled.

facts.label: Defense and armor
facts.value: Anticipation adds 4 Defense Skill per rank (20 at rank 5), and Toughness adds 2% armor from items per rank (10% at rank 5).

facts.label: Multi-target threat
facts.value: Consecration does full damage only to the first 4 enemies and very little to the rest, so it holds threat on about 4 targets.

facts.label: Holy Shield threat
facts.value: Holy Shield moved to row 5. It increases block chance and deals Holy damage on blocks.

facts.label: Raid tanking at 60
facts.note: Untested: the beta capped at level 30, and raids open on 9 Dec 2026.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: Protection was a weak raid tank in Classic because of mana and threat limits, and better suited to dungeons.

facts.label: Blessing of Sanctuary
facts.value: Removed in Forever.

facts.label: Classic tank kit
facts.value: Flask of the Titans, Elixir of the Mongoose, Elixir of the Giants, Greater Stoneshield Potion, Limited Invulnerability Potion, Juju Might, Juju Power and Grilled Squid (from a Classic tank guide).

facts.label: Fire resistance for Onyxia
facts.value: Blizzard asks raids to build fire resistance before Onyxia but gives no number.

facts.label: Classic fire resistance sources
facts.value: Onyxia Scale Cloak (+16), Drakefire Amulet (+15), Juju Ember (+15 for 10 minutes), the Greater Fire Resistance cloak enchant (+15), crafted sets such as Dark Iron, and Fire Protection Potions.

facts.label: Judgement uptime
facts.value: Blizzard frames Retribution's group value around keeping Judgements up; Sacred Arbiter's Holy Strike refreshes every Judgement on the target, other Paladins' included.

facts.label: Unsealed Wrath
facts.value: Melee hits store the active Seal for 15 seconds, up to three stacks. A hit with a different Seal spends them and gives the stored Seal its usual activation chance once per stack.

facts.label: Crit and Vengeance
facts.value: Conviction adds 2%, 4% or 6% crit to attacks and spells. Vengeance now needs Seal of Command and can stack five times.

facts.label: Seal damage
facts.value: Improved Seals has five ranks with the same maximum benefit. Seal of Command adds Holy damage when it procs.

facts.label: Two-handed weapons
facts.value: With a two-handed weapon, the specialization adds 2%, 4% or 6% Holy and Physical damage and lowers threat by 7%, 14% or 20%.

facts.label: Melee hit cap vs raid bosses
facts.note: No Forever value has been published. Precision (Protection) and the Dwarf racial Artisan's Precision both add hit.

facts.label: Champion of the Light
facts.value: Turns Intellect into spell damage; the 16 Oct notes cut it to 10/20/30% across its ranks.
facts.note: Superseded: the 10 November talent data gives Champion of the Light five ranks, up to 60% of your Intellect at rank 5.

facts.label: Retribution threat
facts.value: Instrument of Law was removed. Two-Handed Weapon Specialization now supplies the Retribution threat reduction. Champion of the Light shortens Hammer of Wrath.

facts.label: Blessing of Might
facts.value: In beta, rank 7 gave less attack power than in Classic, possibly a bug (Warcraft Tavern).

facts.label: World buffs
facts.value: Wowhead's Forever data marks Rallying Cry of the Dragonslayer 'No effect while in a raid instance', and warcraft.wiki.gg says world buffs are removed in dungeons and raids.

facts.label: Classic baseline
facts.value: In Classic, Retribution was brought mainly for its buffs.

facts.label: Classic melee kit
facts.value: Elixir of the Giants, Elixir of the Mongoose, Juju Might, Juju Power, Winterfall Firewater, R.O.I.D.S., Major Healing Potion, Free Action Potion, Grilled Squid and Elemental Sharpening Stone.

facts.label: New Forever elixir
facts.value: Warcraft Tavern reports a new Elixir of the Grizzly (Strength plus crit).

facts.label: Launch raids
facts.value: Barrow Deeps (10 players), Hyjal Summit (20) and Onyxia's Lair (40) open on 9 December 2026, all planned to reset weekly.

facts.label: Onyxia's Lair entry
facts.value: Every raider must carry their own Drakefire Amulet in their bags, and Blizzard tells raids to build fire resistance before the fight.
